steps.title: After nidhogg appears
steps.rule: Go to 15m south of the centre.

MainTank.rule: Stand near waymark 2, 4m north-west of the centre.

OffTank.rule: Go to 4m north-east of the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Stand near waymark B, 5m south of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Stand near waymark B, 5m south of the centre.

MainTank.rule: Depends on Glow: Nidhogg → NW wall; Both → near 2 (N 9m); Hraesvelgr → NW wall.

OffTank.rule: Depends on Glow: Nidhogg → NE wall; Both → near 3 (N 9m); Hraesvelgr → NE wall.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Stand near waymark C, 8m south of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: When Stacks includes H2, go to the south wall; when Stacks leaves out H2, stand near waymark C, 8m south of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: When NidhoggTethers includes R1 and OrbColumns leaves out [2, go to the south wall; when NidhoggTethers leaves out R1 and OrbColumns includes [2, go to the south wall; when NidhoggTethers includes R1 and OrbColumns includes [2, stand near waymark C, 8m south of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: When OrbColumns leaves out [2, stand near waymark B, 8m south of the centre; when OrbColumns includes [2, go to the south wall.

steps.title: After fire Resistance Down II on you
steps.cue: Fire Resistance Down II on you
steps.rule: Each role has its own spot.

steps.title: After wyrmclaw hits you
steps.rule: Stand near waymark 2, 6m north of the centre.

OffTank.rule: Stand near waymark B, 6m south of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: Stand near waymark B, 6m south of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Stand near waymark C, 6m south of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: Stand near waymark B, 6m south of the centre.

steps.title: After hallowed Wings cast starts
steps.rule: Depends on WingsNorth: true → near B (S 6m); false → near 2 (N 7m).

RegenHealer.rule: Depends on WingsNorth: true → near C (S 6m); false → near 3 (N 7m).

ShieldHealer.rule: Depends on WingsNorth: true → near B (S 6m); false → near 2 (N 6m).

MeleeDpsA.rule: Depends on WingsNorth: true → near B (S 6m); false → near 2 (N 6m).

MeleeDpsB.rule: Depends on WingsNorth: true → near C (S 6m); false → near 3 (N 6m).

PhysRangedDps.rule: Depends on WingsNorth: true → near B (S 7m); false → near 2 (N 6m).

CasterDps.rule: Depends on WingsNorth: true → near B (S 7m); false → near 2 (N 6m).

steps.title: After sprint on you
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: HraesvelgrDiveStart).

MainTank.rule: Depends on PlumesNear and NidhoggDivesEast: false & true → W wall; true & false → E wall; true & true → NW 4m.

steps.title: After hallowed Plume hits you
steps.rule: If you are in VowTarget: Stand at the centre; otherwise: Stand near waymark B, 9m south of the centre.

OffTank.rule: Stand near waymark B, 9m south of the centre.

RegenHealer.rule: Stand near waymark B, 9m south of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: Stand near waymark C, 9m south of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: If you are in VowTarget: Stand at the centre; otherwise: Stand near waymark C, 9m south of the centre.

steps.title: After sprint on you
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: SecondHraesvelgrStackOnRegen).

steps.title: After sprint on you
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: SecondHraesvelgrStackOnRegen).

steps.title: After sprint on you
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: HraesvelgrDiveStart).

MainTank.rule: Depends on Spreads has MainTank and HotWing: yes & false → SW 15m; no & false → SE wall; no & true → E wall; yes & true → centre.

OffTank.rule: When NidhoggTethers leaves out R2 and Spreads includes OT, go to 13m south of the centre; when NidhoggTethers includes R2 and Spreads leaves out OT, go to the south-east wall; when NidhoggTethers includes R2 and Spreads includes OT, stand at the centre; when NidhoggTethers leaves out R2 and Spreads leaves out OT, go to the east wall.

RegenHealer.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: AkhMornTarget).

ShieldHealer.rule: Depends on Spreads has ShieldHealer and HotWing: no & false → SE wall; yes & true → near A (W 7m); no & true → near D (E 8m).

MeleeDpsA.rule: Depends on Spreads has MeleeDpsA and HotWing: no & false → SE wall; yes & false → SW wall; no & true → near D (E 8m); yes & true → W wall.
